host_delta: Fold packet aggregation into the existing transient FIELD machine handoff: every packet reduces to exactly one of NOW / DELTA / RESIDUE / GATE / NEXT / ARCHIVE without becoming a queue, store, route, or authority source.
law: Packet egress is derived, never packet-authorized. GATE → NOW → RESIDUE → NEXT → DELTA → ARCHIVE. Only caller-supplied CURRENT/explicit selection context can create NOW. DELTA requires material change plus host-attested sufficient EVIDENCE; unwitnessed change is RESIDUE. Uppercase compatibility aliases and inert RETURN-to-CURRENT/replan semantics are preserved. STOP suppresses continuation; historical/superseded material remains ARCHIVE unless explicitly reactivated.

/showcase-manifest.json — FIELD root touch only; no new route/version
/.github/workflows/public-surface-check.yml — run A-H reducer proof inside existing JIT FIELD handoff gate
/lib/field-egress-reducer.mjs + /tools/field-egress-reducer-selftest.mjs — restore recovered GATE → NOW → RESIDUE → NEXT → DELTA → ARCHIVE precedence
preserves: historical worker packets remain non-runnable by presence
no new route, dashboard, queue, store, planner, ontology, or canonical packet cache
verify: node tools/field-egress-reducer-selftest.mjs  # A-Y + aliases + inert RETURN + authority/evidence hardening
FIELD route adapter emits material route_touch DELTA with evidence.sufficient=true only when its own manifest/local catch-up witness says changed
residue: The reducer classifies egress only; it does not choose project priority or execute NEXT.
Evidence sufficiency is asserted by the owning adapter/host; the generic reducer does not infer domain proof.
No second packet surface, queue, store, planner or authority source is introduced.
stop: After exact-head green proof, close packet egress again. Do not broaden GATE into generic unresolved state.
correction: PR #575 correctly hardened NOW authority and witnessed DELTA but regressed the immediately preceding uppercase compatibility aliases and inert RETURN-to-CURRENT/replan handling.
Restore uppercase OBJECT / AUTHORITY / STATE_IN / DELTA / EVIDENCE / STATE_OUT / RESIDUE / WAITING / NEXT / STOP compatibility while retaining #575 authority semantics.
Precomputed egress labels remain advisory only and cannot manufacture attention or continuation.
RETURN-to-CURRENT/replan-only prose is terminal re-entry, not NEXT.
FIELD root attests the route-touch witness it already owns so a legitimate changed-route projection remains DELTA under the stronger evidence law.
Canonical exists:false / material:false fields do not manufacture attention.
Only explicit external/world/human WAITING is GATE; generic unresolved/internal WAITING is RESIDUE.
The external-vs-internal predicate is recursive across string/object/array WAITING values; a non-empty array alone does not grant GATE.
Named waiting_on/blocked_by fields require external semantics for GATE; otherwise they remain RESIDUE.
